parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own Prowl destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-prowl` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). The gateway composes an Apprise `prowl://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers the notification via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Two channels are available: the free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters (`apikey_secret`).
parameters.gateway_body_template: apikey=${ customer_secrets.PROWL_APIKEY }&application={* _escape_json(_body.title or "UnitySVC") *}&description={* _escape_json(_body.body or _body.title or "") *}&event={* _escape_json(_body.title or "") *}&priority=0
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Prowl destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to Prowl API (no Apprise)

apikey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Prowl apikey
